title:
3 rule changes.
*One pattern*

lines.say: You've seen three housing changes in one season. Put them together and you can see a pattern.
In July, private owners no longer had to wait 15 months to buy an HDB resale flat.
In August, BTO and EC income ceilings went up, to 16,000 and 18,000 dollars.
Useful so far? Follow for more.
And families get an extra ballot chance for each child, from February 2027.
Each one lets more people into the market.
Most people read these one by one. Comment WHY and we'll show you what they mean together.

caption:
Three housing changes in one season. Put them together and you can see a pattern. 🏛️

July: private owners no longer wait 15 months to buy an HDB resale flat.
August: BTO and EC income ceilings up to $16,000 and $18,000.
From February 2027: an extra ballot chance per child for families.

Each one lets more people into the market.

Comment WHY and we'll show you what they mean together 👇

Not a forecast.
